build_anthropic_kwargs: build Anthropic messages.create() kwargs from model, messages, and optional tools with configurable params
convert_messages: convert OpenAI-format messages to Anthropic system and messages tuple with base_url support
convert_tools: convert OpenAI tool schemas to Anthropic input_schema format
normalize_response: normalize Anthropic response content blocks into a structured NormalizedResponse with tool calls and reasoning
extract_cache_stats: extract Anthropic cache_read and cache_creation token counts from a response object
